reason: The plugin restores titles for persisted cold sessions and writes them to the projection cache so the session sidebar shows meaningful titles instead of workspace directory names.

summaries.zh: 该插件通过回填持久化冷会话的标题投影缓存，让会话侧边栏显示真实标题而不是工作区目录名。
summaries.en: This plugin backfills titles for persisted cold sessions so the session sidebar shows meaningful titles instead of workspace directory names.

capabilities: Folds session projection events into title state
Writes session titles to a local projection cache
Runs background and periodic incremental refreshes
